protocol_notes: Release builds with opt-in GPUI instrumentation; same 1240 by 878 point window and initial database backup. Existing 40-row pagination retained.
Each matched scroll phase uses 24 native CUA wheel steps: down, down, up, up, repeated six times. These are not physical trackpad input or continuous frame-rate measurements.
Baseline precedes candidate; trial order was not randomized. Warm caches and substantial unrelated host load limit causal precision.
CPU 100 percent means one logical CPU. Sampled phase percentiles include pauses; compare as observational context, not a standardized throughput score.
Initial baseline CPU ticks were converted using explicit 125/3 correction receipt; original samples retained. Calibration ratio to Python process CPU clock was 1.000187664.
Footprint sums are sampled process accounting, not deduplicated physical memory or exact allocation peaks. GPU/ANE allocations are not fully observed.
Input histogram boundaries have about 100 ms uncertainty. The exploratory first baseline personal scroll was invalid and excluded.
Filtered phases include caret redraws. Candidate inference phase includes time after completion, although each drawn frame had a preceding active-job UI sample.
Selection spanning recycled rows, complete VoiceOver traversal, physical keyboard/trackpad behavior and M3 hardware remain unverified.
